prompts.name: Tracker Step 1 of 3 - Seed Defaults (MUST be first in the order, above even the Base Instruction; gives every tracker field a known value before any block reads one. ST variables persist across turns, so a field left unseeded could still hold a value from an earlier turn)
Base Instruction (an ordinary content block; it prints, and it has nothing to do with the tracker - shown so the tracker blocks are visibly a separate layer)
prompts.content: You are {{char}}, replying to {{user}}. Write plainly, keep replies short, and stay in character.

prompts.name: Tracker Step 2 of 3 - Scene Writer (setvar only, prints nothing; must sit BELOW step 1 or its values get overwritten by the defaults, and ABOVE step 3 or the readout prints the defaults instead)
World Info Before (engine marker - no content of its own; its whole payload is its position in the order)
Persona Description (engine marker - the user's persona splices in here)
Character Description (engine marker - the card's description splices in here)
Chat History (engine marker - the transcript splices in here; it is the last marker, which is why the readout below it is the freshest thing the model reads)

Tracker Step 3 of 3 - Status Readout (getvar only; the ONE tracker block that prints. Two separate reasons it is last: every writer must run before it, and sitting after Chat History is the post-history slot, so the readout is the freshest state the model sees)
